item.title: Sam Darnold: Could return to practice Week 3
item.description:
Darnold (glute), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game in Arizona, is "recovering faster than anyone had anticipated" and has a "pretty good chance" of practicing at some point during Week 3, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Brock Bowers: Trending toward Week 3 return
item.description:
Bowers (knee), who is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Chargers, is expected to sit out Week 2 but appears likely to make his season debut Week 3 in New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Keenan Allen: Facing league suspension
item.description:
Allen "is facing a minimum three-game suspension" in connection with his August arrest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Michael Penix: Could start in Week 3
item.description:
Penix (knee) may start Thursday's game against the Packers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jalen McMillan: Should play on snap count
item.description:
McMillan (knee) is set to play Sunday against the Browns but "is not expected to have a full-time role just yet," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
